description: Extract STRUCTURED FIELDS from a document image: invoices, receipts, ID cards — or any custom JSON schema you supply. Every field returns {value, confidence, box} where the confidence and box come from the OCR geometry (never model guesswork); absent fields are null. preset="zatca" additionally decodes the Saudi ZATCA e-invoice QR (TLV) and cross-validates it against the printed fields — use it for Saudi tax invoices. Arabic-first accuracy. 5 credits/page (zatca 7).

api_key.description: Optional Auto-Reader OCR key (nsk_live_...). If omitted, a free trial key is auto-provisioned and returned to you in the result.

image_base64.description: The document image as base64 (data: URI prefix accepted).

preset.description: Built-in schema. Use zatca for Saudi e-invoices (adds QR validation).

schema.description: Custom extraction schema instead of a preset: an object whose keys are the fields you want, values describing them, e.g. {"policy_number": "string|null"}.

name: extract_document
